note: Bluff-top state beach campground at the south end of San Clemente, beside I-5 (Avenida Calafia exit). The hookup loop (sites 1-72, pull-through) sits inland; the non-hookup loops (73-160) lie between it and the bluff, with premium sites 81-90 at the edge overlooking the ocean. Steep trails lead down the bluff and through a tunnel under the coastal railroad to a mile-long beach. The visitor center is a 1934 ranger's cottage. Dogs are not allowed on the beach or trails. --Claude
